categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Modifies signing logic affecting RPC PSBT processing in `src/script/sign.cpp` and tests in `test/functional/rpc_psbt.py`; category definition notes that descriptor/PSBT changes without wallet code belong to RPC.
categories.rationale: Fixes a correctness and privacy issue where RPC methods like `descriptorprocesspsbt` and `utxoupdatepsbt` leak unrelated MuSig2 participant pubkeys, derivation paths, and leaf hashes into PSBT fields (issue #36323). Correctness of returned data and preventing exposure of sensitive key material are top priorities in RPC.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: No wallet code is changed (`src/script/sign.cpp` and `test/functional/rpc_psbt.py` only); category notes that descriptor or PSBT changes affecting only RPC without wallet code are rpc, not wallet.
categories.rationale: Does not touch wallet code or wallet interfaces.
